name: budabit-gastown-integration
description: An extension for integrating Gas Town with Nostr

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm e2e
scripts.manifest:generate: pnpm exec budabit-generate --title 'Gas Town Dashboard' --type tool --app-url "${GASTOWN_APP_URL:-http://localhost:5173}" --icon "${GASTOWN_ICON:-Building2}" --image "${GASTOWN_IMAGE:-https://placehold.co/600x400?text=Gas+Town+Dashboard}" --button-title 'Open Dashboard' --identifier 'gastown-dashboard' --permissions 'nostr:publish,nostr:query,nostr:subscribe,nostr:unsubscribe,storage:get,storage:set,storage:remove,storage:keys,ui:toast,ui:resize' --nostr-kinds '14,40,41,42,1059,30315,30316,30318,30319,30320,30321,30322,30323,30325,38383,38384,38385,38386' --slot-type repo-tab --slot-label 'Gas Town' --slot-path gastown
scripts.widget:publish:blossom: pnpm widget:build && pnpm exec budabit-publish --upload-first --blossom https://blossom.primal.net --artifact ../iframe-app/dist/index.html

author: Biz
